findings: HMB has no demineralised makeup, blowdown or cycle-loss streams in the NG cases (only IF-03 stream 28 = 13.443 t/h on SRC-LDO-100). Blowdown assumed 1 % of HP feedwater (about 1 t/h) plus 1 % cycle losses, total makeup about 3 t/h; add these streams to the HMB (both NG and LDO cases) and recheck demin and tank sizing.

Demin demand on LDO = 13.443 + about 3 = 16.5 t/h; 72 h autonomy (DP-OWNR-0038) needs 1,188 m3 + about 300 m3 assumed HRSG fill = about 1,490 m3 -> 2 x 800 m3 tanks (both tanks needed, so 2 x 50 % gives no redundancy). HRSG water volume must be confirmed by the HRSG vendor; refill after an LDO event takes about 3 days at 25 m3/h.

SWRO chain sized: permeate 32 m3/h at 42 % recovery = feed 76 m3/h, brine 44 m3/h. The register has no energy recovery device or booster; the HP pump sizing assumes an isobaric ERD (90 kW LV). Without ERD the HP pump needs about 200 kW MV (placeholder was 315 kW). Feedwater salinity range is 21.8-38.2 PSU and 6.9-27 degC (DP-OWNR-0015/0013): membrane design must cover both layers.

Brine (44 m3/h) and EDI reject have no equipment or destination in the register; brine is assumed discharged to the CW outfall (10,197 t/h, stream 26) and EDI reject recycled to SWRO feed. Confirm against EIA discharge conditions; WWT package sized only for plant drains/washes (20 m3/h peak).

Aux load AL-15 = 450 kW versus about 180 kW running from this sizing (HP 84, feed 19, EDI feed 10, EDI rectifier 10, forwarding 12, ancillaries about 45); AL-15 also covers condensate polishing (00LDA, not in my systems). AL-15 is conservative by about 250 kW; without ERD it would be about 300 kW. Review with the aux_load owner.

Cycle chemistry is not defined in the design parameters. Ammonia dosing is consistent with AVT(O); an oxygen scavenger contradicts AVT(O) (oxidising, no reducing agents) and is only justified for lay-up or commissioning, so the skid tags 00QCA10AP003/004/BB002 could be deleted or kept as lay-up duty; decide and record the cycle chemistry as a decision. Phosphate/caustic only needed for HP drum trim.

Potable water: only UV disinfection is in the register; SWRO permeate (boron 2.4-3.4 mg/l in seawater, DP-OWNR-0018) needs remineralisation and residual chlorination/boron check for drinking water; no service water or raw water storage is registered (SWRO permeate tank used as buffer).

Neutralisation of the pits/tanks (00GMA10BB001, 00GNA10BB002) needs acid and caustic dosing, no acid tank or dosing pump exists in 00QCA; the caustic tank 00QCA10BB003 is sized for HP drum trim only. Mixed-bed regeneration chemicals are also not registered (resin exchange assumed).

The GT water injection pressure (60 bar, stream 28) cannot be supplied by the forwarding pumps (70 m head); equipment 10MBN10 (GT liquid fuel and water injection module) must include the high-pressure water injection pump. Check its scope and IF-03 terminal point pressure (lesson L-EPCE-0001).
Metering pumps are below the smallest motor size of the brief (0.75 kW); 1.5 kW placeholders reduced to 0.75 kW; sump/transfer pump placeholders (7.5-11 kW) were 2-3 x oversize and have been reduced.
